goal: Use the search box to search for the given term and open the article about the Playwright end-to-end testing framework, so that the article page 'Playwright (software)' is shown.
notes: Typing in the search box opens a list of suggestions; choosing the suggestion 'Playwright (software)' or pressing Enter both lead to the article.

checks.suggestions_open: A list of search suggestions is open under the search box
checks.on_article: The page heading is 'Playwright (software)' and the article describes a testing framework

article_shown.when: The page heading is 'Playwright (software)' and the first paragraph describes an end-to-end testing framework

search_results_only.when: A 'Search results' page lists matching pages instead of showing the article
search_results_only.note: the exact title should open the article directly; adjust the term or the goal

no_results.when: The page says there were no results matching the query
